messages:
emily: Planning a small 'Snackpack' refapp drop + 10-min tutorial next Thu. Goal: drive 120 GH clones, 80 site visits, 40 webinar RSVPs. Need owners for: launch post (blog + HN blurb), bench one-pager, 10-min demo script, RSVP+thank-you flow, and inbound lead routing. who owns what?

sam: I can do the blog + HN blurb. will draft two angles: hands-on quickstart and benchmarks-driven.

noor: Ill run the bench and produce a single graphic. plan: p50/p95 latency, tokens per second, and $/1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated. will include a 1-line methods note: 512 tokens, batch=3.

chris: Ill wire the RSVP form + thank-you email. propose capture fields: name, email, company_size, job_title, use_case. add utm params: utm_source=snackpack, utm_campaign=ref-labs. will add 1-click calendar add.

emily: for routing: rule idea: company_size>100 or job_title contains "infra|platform" -> AE queue; else SDR nurture. tag all with "ref:snackpack".

sam: copy iteration: ill prepare three hero variants (outcome-led, technical, playful) and set up an A/B test for 72h. KPI: CTR->RSVP >= 2.5%.

noor: bench ETA: tomorrow noon. will paste a tiny table in the ticket and attach PNG.

chris: RSVP flow note: if job_title empty then try LinkedIn lookup via integration; fallback tag `role:unknown`. will document Zapier steps.

emily: good. asset-bot: create MK ticket and add checklist (copy, bench image, demo script, RSVP page, zap). remind 48h before.

asset-bot: Ticket MK-5333 created: "Snackpack Ref-Labs launch" assigned: emily, sam, noor, chris. Reminder set for 48h before launch.

sam: scheduling a 20m prep sync Mon 09:00 PT to review slide, demo script, and RSVP flow. anyone needs more time?

noor: confirmed. will upload raw numbers and PNG to MK-5333.

chris: confirmed. will share Zap blueprint and email copy in the ticket.

emily: thanks team. final ask: keep demo under 10m, show setup, quick 60s long-context example, then bench slide. :rocket:
